name: alternate-incline-dumbbell-flys.html
instructions:
1. Set up for alternating incline dumbbell fly by setting an incline bench to an angle of around 30-45 degrees.
2. Grab a set of dumbbells and sit on the end of the incline bench with the dumbbells resting on your thighs.
3. Lay back on the bench and extend your arms up, holding the dumbbells with a neutral grip (palms facing each other.)
4. Bend your arms slightly. This is the starting position for the exercise.
5. Slowly lower your left arm out to your side following the path of a semi-circle while keeping your right arm fixed.
6. Once the dumbbell gets about level with your chest, squeeze the chest muscle and raise the dumbbell back up using the same path of motion as you did on the way down.
7. Now repeat the same movement on your right arm.
8. Repeat for desired reps.
